# M&S Electric

> Commercial electrical contractor serving the Kansas City metro since 2011: commercial electrical, fire alarm systems, low voltage, maintenance and service, and specialty electrical work.

- Award: 2026 ABC Heart of America STEP Platinum Safety Award
